answer: Each agent plants a willow beacon post for 70 credits. Each epoch a falcon ping tests each post, answered with a fresh echo. A miss decays the bond 12 credits; two misses burn it. A lantern log lists every ping; auditors replay it and catch copies. First 36 credits, k-th 36+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,533,500 for a 40,000 pool. No operator answers 1,000 pings at once, so rented beacons fail. An honest agent pays 36 once and keeps a full share.
